prompt: Who was the Vice Admiral in charge of the Carrier Division the Japanese carrier Hiyō was in when she was sunk?
answer: At the time Hiyō was sunk on June 20, 1944, her Carrier Division 2 was commanded by **Rear Admiral Takatsugu Jōjima**—not a vice admiral. The overall Japanese Mobile Fleet commander was **Vice Admiral Jisaburō Ozawa**.
